description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveMessageApp查询互动消息应用信息
name: DescribeLiveMessageApp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

AppId.description_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application
AppId.description_zh: 所查询的互动消息应用ID

AppKey.description_en: The AppKey of the interactive messaging application. It is used to authorize operations related to the application ID
AppKey.description_zh: 互动消息应用的AppKey，在进行与该互动消息应用ID相关的各种鉴权操作时需要该信息

AppName.description_en: The name of the interactive messaging application

AppSign.description_en: The signature of the interactive messaging application. It is required by the interactive messaging SDK
AppSign.description_zh: 互动消息应用签名，互动消息服务SDK需要该信息

AuditType.description_en:
The content moderation method. Valid values:

0: Content moderation is disabled.
1: Built-in content moderation is used.
2: Custom content moderation is used
AuditType.description_zh:
安全审核方式。取值：
0：不开启安全审核。
1：内置安全审核。
2：自定义安全审核

AuditUrl.description_en: The URL for content moderation. This parameter is returned when the value of AuditType is 2
AuditUrl.description_zh: AuditType取值为2时提供的安全审核地址

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the interactive messaging application was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒

Disable.description_en: Indicates whether the interactive messaging application is disabled
Disable.description_zh: 是否禁用互动消息应用

EventCallbackUrl.description_en: The callback URL for events such as user logon, logoff, joining a group, and leaving a group. An empty value indicates that callbacks are disabled
EventCallbackUrl.description_zh: 用户登录、登出、加入、离开群组等事件的回调地址，若为空则不开启事件回调

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the interactive messaging application was modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 修改时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒

MsgLifeCycle.description_en:
The retention period of group messages in the application. Valid values:

0 (default): 30 days
1: 90 days
2: 180 days
MsgLifeCycle.description_zh:
App内群组消息的存储时效档位，取值：

0：默认值，存储30天。
1：存储90天。
2：存储180天
